# artie_column_hashing_salt (Resource)

Artie Column Hashing Salt resource. This resource manages salts used when hashing column values in pipelines. Reference a salt's `uuid` from an `artie_pipeline`'s `column_hashing_salt_uuid` to apply it to any table that has `columns_to_hash` set.

Salts belong to the whole company, so this resource needs an API key with access to **All environments**: either full access, or the `column_hashing_salts:read`, `column_hashing_salts:write` and `column_hashing_salts:delete` scopes. An environment-bound key gets a 403. If your main key is bound to one environment, manage salts through a second `provider` block with an `alias`. Pipelines can keep using the environment-bound key to reference the salt's `uuid`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Salts belong to the whole company, so manage them with a key that has access to All environments
# (full access, or the column_hashing_salts scopes).
variable "artie_workspace_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

provider "artie" {
  alias   = "workspace"
  api_key = var.artie_workspace_api_key
}

resource "artie_column_hashing_salt" "pii" {
  provider    = artie.workspace
  name        = "PII"
  description = "Hashes customer emails and phone numbers"
}

# Pipelines can stay on the default provider, even with an environment-bound key.
resource "artie_pipeline" "postgres_to_snowflake" {
  name               = "PostgreSQL to Snowflake"
  source_reader_uuid = artie_source_reader.postgres.uuid
  tables = {
    "public.customer" = {
      name            = "customer"
      schema          = "public"
      columns_to_hash = ["email", "phone"]
    }
  }
  column_hashing_salt_uuid   = artie_column_hashing_salt.pii.uuid
  destination_connector_uuid = artie_connector.snowflake.uuid
  destination_config = {
    database = "ANALYTICS"
    schema   = "PUBLIC"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A human-readable name for the column hashing salt.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the salt's purpose.
- `salt` (String, Sensitive) The salt value used when hashing column values. If omitted, Artie will generate a strong random salt. This value is sensitive and cannot be rotated in place; changing it forces replacement.

### Read-Only

- `uuid` (String)
